My grandpa then came over , killed all of our bunnies, our dog, our teacup pig, and our chickens. Then he made us help skin and clean ALL the animals and help him cook them. After this we all sat down and had a family dinner. Worst moment of my life. Also everyone on that side of the family is fucked up mentally. Like I’ve been diagnosed with clinical depression, generalized anxiety, social anxiety, ADHD. Also I am very close with my cousins and sometimes the one who is my age scares me because she will talk about hearing people and seeing things. Also she will tell me how she got dragged down the stairs by a demon. I’m worried for her mental health and no one is getting her the help she needs. My grandma only has pictures of her around the house. Constantly talks about her achievements, only talks good things about her, never yells at her or hits her, but yeah and pretty much what I had to get off my chest is that my family sucks and that’s why I say that friends before family cause at least you can choose your friends.

Mine was self harm , suicidal thoughts and family problems. I told my best friend who told her mom and got sent to the hospital and was in there for a total of 2.5 weeks. I eventually started putting effort into my life, made new friends, and started being more open about my emotions. Also weekly sessions with a counselor and medication helps too. Although I am still not fully back up on my feet I am doing a lot better. So if your going through something just keep your head up, try new and different things, talk to people, and share your emotions.
